capsules.title: To whoever needs to hear this
capsules.message: You are doing better than you think. The things that feel impossible today will be a story you tell later. Keep going.

capsules.title: Our last day of college
capsules.message: We promised we would meet here again. If you are reading this, I hope all of us showed up. Bring chai.

capsules.title: A note on stubborn dreams
capsules.message: I started learning guitar today. By the time you read this I hope I can play at least one song without looking at my fingers.

capsules.title: Open when you finish your first job
capsules.message: Remember the nervous version of you who rehearsed introductions in the mirror. Be kind to them. They got you here.

capsules.title: Monsoon of 2025
capsules.message: It rained for nine days straight and we still walked to the beach. Never let anyone tell you that was a bad idea.
